messages.content: Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle

reasoning:
The user wants an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle. I need to create a fun, recognizable SVG drawing. Let me design it: bicycle (two wheels with spokes, frame, handlebars, seat), pelican body on the seat, big beak with pouch, wing on handlebars, legs pedaling.

Let me build a reasonably clean SVG with coordinates. Canvas 400x300 maybe.

Bicycle: wheels centered at (100, 230) and (300, 230), radius 45. Frame: triangle-ish lines connecting. Handlebars at ~(300, 165). Seat at ~(150, 160).

Pelican: body ellipse above seat around (170, 120), neck up to head (250, 80), long beak extending right with pouch. Wing reaching to handlebars. Legs down to pedals.

Let me write it carefully.

Wheels: circles with stroke, spokes as lines.

Frame: lines: rear wheel hub (100,230) to seat tube (160,165), (160,165) to bottom bracket (200,230), bottom bracket to front hub (300,230), seat tube to head tube (295,175), head tube to handlebars, and seat stay rear hub to seat.

Pedals: crank circle at (200,230), pedal lines.

Pelican body: ellipse cx 175 cy 130 rx 55 ry 40, white with gray outline. Tail on left. Neck: path from (210,110) to head at (260,75). Head circle r 16 at (265,72). Eye dot. Beak: long triangle from head to right, upper beak line to (350,85), pouch below as curved path to (300,105) back to head.

Wing: path from body to handlebar (305,165).

Legs: from body bottom (185,165) down to pedal.

Add ground line maybe. Colors: pelican white body, orange beak, bicycle dark frame.

Let me write SVG code.

Spokes: several lines per wheel.

I'll produce final answer with the SVG code block and brief description.
answer:
